decisionReason: The candidate initialized natively, adapted all current material assignments, and captured all 13 matched states. However, object-aligned RGB MAE is large in highlighted, dimmed, aperture, and rear-back states (see the per-state summaries); only initial/reset and background samples are close. Repeat capture noise measured zero in this run, but no approved cross-backend tolerance exists. Keep the opt-in experimental pending focused transparency/material-output investigation and independent parity criteria.

evidencePackaging.format: Compact deterministic projection of the passing Playwright raw JSON report; measured values are copied from that report without recalculation except where aggregation is explicitly named.

teachingStates.criteria: registered target, highlight/dim state, aperture, rear-back, bellows deformation, optical helper, reset, and Ground Glass checks completed

sourceOwnership.model: independent WebGL2 RTT; source material and geometry UUIDs match Observer source UUIDs while candidate NodeMaterial UUIDs remain separate

repeatCaptureNoiseCalibration.thresholdInterpretation: Same-mode repeat stability only; not a cross-backend parity threshold.

materialAware.measurement: Development-only CPU callback instrumentation; browser scheduling and GPU execution are not measured here.

performance.interpretation: CPU callback and lifecycle counters only; no GPU render-time measurement.

architectureRiseRegression.command: OBSERVER_VISUAL_PARITY_REQUIRED=1 OBSERVER_NATIVE_WEBGPU_REQUIRED=1 OBSERVER_OUTPUT_POLICY=material-aware npx playwright test --config=playwright.observer-backend-benchmark.config.ts src/tests/benchmarks/observer-visual-parity.bench.ts --workers=1

limitations: Visual parity thresholds remain provisional pending independent review of measured noise and ROI differences.
Ghost-camera rendering is verified separately by the candidate E2E visibility differential and is excluded from the matched 13-state triad.
Ground Glass remains the existing independent WebGL RTT.
